change: Home Assistant entity ids genericised in the public repository at the owner's request.

deployment_unaffected.method: paperclip-gladosd restarted to load the moved config, then /health read back
deployment_unaffected.note: 6 + 4 is the real list, not the 3 + 4 placeholders, so the override loaded. /health exposes counts only, never entity names.

method: The real list was moved out of gladosd.py's DEFAULTS into the deployment's local, unpublished config.json. load_config() does a flat dict update, so the two keys replace the published defaults wholesale. The published defaults are placeholders.

placeholders_resolve_to_nothing.note: The first run of this check returned 000 for every entity INCLUDING the controls - a wrong env var name, so no request was made at all. Without the positive controls that would have read as 'the placeholders do not exist'.
placeholders_resolve_to_nothing.positive_controls: two entity ids from the live install, held back for the same reason the rest were: both returned 200. Naming them here would defeat the change.

remaining_published_vs_deployed_differen: gladosd.py's docstring host addresses, and these two entity lists. Both are now stated in docs/SERVER.md.
repo_scan_after: no occurrence of any real entity id remains anywhere in the published tree, this file included

tests.note: run on the live host against the live fly and real sockets

why_not_just_edit_the_published_copy: That would leave the published server/ code silently different from the code the measurements were taken against. Moving the house-specific values into local config keeps published == deployed for the logic and puts the private data where private data belongs.
